question: 张三Q1完成了多少？离目标还差多少？
c_sql:
SELECT 
    salesperson,
    quarter,
    target_amount,
    actual_amount,
    (target_amount - actual_amount) AS remaining_amount
FROM targets
WHERE salesperson = '张三'
  AND quarter = 'Q1';
d_sql:
SELECT 
    salesperson,
    quarter,
    target_amount,
    actual_amount,
    (target_amount - actual_amount) AS remaining_amount
FROM targets
WHERE salesperson = '张三'
  AND quarter = '2025Q1';

question: 上个季度各部门的费效比怎么样？
why: '费效比'不是字段名，需要理解为cost_price/sales_amount
c_sql:
SELECT 
    department,
    SUM(cost_price) / SUM(sales_amount) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM orders
WHERE sales_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  AND sales_amount > 0
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department;
d_sql:
SELECT 
    department,
    ROUND(SUM(cost_price) / SUM(sales_amount), 4) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM orders
WHERE 
    sales_date >= '2025-01-01' 
    AND sales_date < '2025-04-01'
    AND status = '已完成'
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department;

question: 哪些大客户最近没下单了？
c_sql:
SELECT 
    c.cust_id,
    c.cust_name,
    c.contact_phone,
    c.level,
    c.region,
    MAX(o.sales_date) AS last_order_date
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.cust_name = o.cust_name
WHERE c.level = 'A'
GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name, c.contact_phone, c.level, c.region
HAVING MAX(o.sales_date) IS NULL 
    OR MAX(o.sales_date) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
ORDER BY last_order_date ASC;
d_sql:
SELECT 
    c.cust_name,
    c.level,
    c.region,
    c.contact_phone,
    MAX(o.sales_date) AS last_order_date
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.cust_name = o.cust_name
WHERE c.level = 'A'
GROUP BY c.cust_name, c.level, c.region, c.contact_phone
HAVING MAX(o.sales_date) IS NULL 
    OR MAX(o.sales_date) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
ORDER BY last_order_date ASC;

question: 进行中的大单有哪些？超过20万的
why: 需要知道status枚举值是'进行中'而非'in_progress'
c_sql:
SELECT 
    order_id,
    cust_name,
    sales_amount,
    cost_price,
    profit_margin,
    sales_date,
    salesperson,
    region,
    department,
    status,
    phone,
    id_card
FROM orders
WHERE status = '进行中'
  AND sales_amount > 200000
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;
d_sql:
SELECT 
    order_id,
    cust_name,
    sales_amount,
    sales_date,
    salesperson,
    region,
    department
FROM orders
WHERE status = '进行中'
  AND sales_amount > 200000
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;
